entities.summary: Acrion was a Locrian from Magna Graecia and a Pythagorean philosopher. He is mentioned by Valerius Maximus under the name of Arion. According to William Smith, Arion is a false reading of Acrion. Acrion was a philosophers & thinkers from Epizephyrian Locris.
